name: Scotland

flag.description: A blue field with a white diagonal cross (saltire) running from corner to corner.
flag.symbolism: The saltire is the cross of St Andrew, Scotland's patron saint, who is said to have been crucified on an X-shaped cross.

hook: Scotland is the white X on blue that the Union Jack is built on: strip away all the red and this is what is left.
trivia: Legend says the saltire first appeared as white clouds in a blue sky before a battle in 832, and it is often claimed as one of the oldest national flags still in use.
The Scottish saltire supplies the white diagonal cross on the Union Jack.
